title: gardenia augusta var. ovalifolia
intro: Gardenia augusta var. ovalifolia, commonly known as the oval-leaf gardenia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It is known for its fragrant white flowers and glossy oval-shaped leaves. The oval-leaf gardenia has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its sedative, anti-anxiety, and antimicrobial effects.
